description: Main frontend source code for a Flutter-based Tic Tac Toe app, defining theme, main app widget, home screen with mode selection, game screen with gameplay logic, UI components such as board, score, and indicators, and embedded game logic including AI move decision and winner detection.

classes.name: TicTacToeApp
classes.description: Root widget that sets up the theme and home screen.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: Screen allowing users to select game mode (vs Player or vs Computer).

classes.name: _ModeCard
classes.description: Interactive card widget for selecting game modes.

classes.name: GameScreen
classes.description: Main gameplay widget managing game state, logic, and UI.

classes.name: _TurnIndicator
classes.description: Widget showing which player's turn it is.

classes.name: _PlayerChip
classes.description: Visual indicator for players with highlighting.

classes.name: _ScoreBar
classes.description: Displays current game scores for each player and draws.

classes.name: _BoardCell
classes.description: Widget for individual cell with tap handling and animation.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the app that runs the Flutter app.

methods.name: _buildTheme
methods.description: Configures and returns the application's ThemeData based on the Ocean Professional palette.

methods.name: _startGame
methods.description: Starts a new game with the selected mode.

methods.name: _onCellTap
methods.description: Handles user tapping on a game cell.

methods.name: _evaluateBoardAndMaybeContinue
methods.description: Checks for a winner or draw after each move and triggers dialog if game ends.

methods.name: _makeComputerMove
methods.description: AI logic to choose and make the best move.

methods.name: _chooseBestAIMove
methods.description: Determines the AI's next move based on simple heuristics like winning or blocking.

methods.name: _detectWinner
methods.description: Analyzes the board to see if there's a winner.

methods.name: _isBoardFull
methods.description: Checks for a draw condition (full board).

methods.name: _showEndDialog
methods.description: Displays dialog with game result and options to restart or exit.
